messages:
maria_cust: Hi team — getting a 413 from POST /v1/rerank when we include our full docset. No other errors in logs, just "Payload Too Large". Anyone seen this?

alex_support: sorry you're hitting that — can you paste a redacted request + the exact response body? also which model are you calling?

maria_cust: model=redwood-rerank-1. here's a trimmed repro (PII removed):
```json
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "query": "Analyze the user intent across these documents for product matching... (very long query)",
  "documents": [
    {"id": "d1", "text": "<~35k chars truncated>"},
    {"id": "d2", "text": "<~28k chars>"},
    {"id": "d3", "text": "<~40k chars>"}
    // ~1,200 docs in real payload
  ]
}
```
Response:
```json
HTTP/1.1 413 Payload Too Large
{
  "error": "request size exceeds limit",
  "code": "input_size_exceeded",
  "details": "token_count: 75000"
}
```

alex_support: thanks — that details field is helpful. quick notes: rerank has both per-request token ceilings and doc_count guidance. for hosted tier the practical token ceiling is ~65k tokens (varies by model & sequences). the payload you pasted would blow past that if each doc is tens of KB.

maria_cust: ah ok — we thought we could send all passages and let the server trim. the error message is pretty opaque though. can the API return a friendly hint (e.g., doc_count, token_count) instead of generic 413? our product UX depends on parsing the error to auto-chunk.

alex_support: agree — the current 413 is not great for developer UX. two options for you now:
- client-side: chunk docs into passages (e.g., 1k–2k char windows) and call rerank on candidate passages or use embedding pre-filtering to reduce doc set
- short-term: truncate document text to first N chars (fast, but may lose context)

If you want, we can triage an eng ticket to add explicit fields in the 413 payload (doc_count, token_estimate, recommended_max_docs).

support-bot: Automated: please reference KB article https://docs.redwood.ai/rerank/limits for limits & chunking patterns.

ingrid_sre: tagging infra — if this is causing customer-facing outages we can consider increasing limits for dedicated customers, but hosted can't silently accept arbitrarily large requests. also want to capture exact token estimator used (we use model tokenization + some slack).

erin_product: +1 to improving error wording. suggested format: {"error":"input_size_exceeded", "token_estimate": ####, "max_tokens": ####, "recommended_action": "chunk_or_embed_prefilter"} — gives clear machine-readable guidance.

maria_cust: short-term we'd prefer a server-side hint in the response so our client can auto-fix. long-term might do passage-level reranking. can you escalate?

alex_support: will escalate. please email sample payload (redacted) to support@redwood.ai and I'll attach to the ticket. temporary workaround: try sending only first 1,500 chars per doc and run a quick embedding-based prefilter to reduce doc set to top 200, then rerank those.

maria_cust: will try that today. can you open a follow-up ticket for the UX change?

alex_support: opened INC-2291 and linked KB request: https://internal.redwood.ai/inc/INC-2291 — description: "Improve rerank 413 to include token_estimate & suggested fixes; doc_count guidance". assigned to eng-ml.

ingrid_sre: noted — please include load samples in the ticket so we can estimate cost of any server-side chunking feature.

alex_support: looping back — if you hit failures after doing client chunking, paste the smaller request and response and we'll triage fast. :thumbsup:

maria_cust: thanks everyone — trimming now. appreciate the quick responses. :pray:
